title: conyza pinnata
intro: Conyza pinnata, commonly known as Mexican daisy or horseweed, is a flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Conyza pinnata include wound healing, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Conyza pinnata also exhibit anti-diabetic, anti-hypertensive, and anti-inflammatory activities.
